description: Charming hosts interactive web apps that agents can create, update, and render inline. Apps are served from Charming and can be built over HTTP, MCP, or the service’s CLI.
summary: Charming exposes three developer integration surfaces on charm.ing: a REST/HTTP API, an OAuth-protected streamable-HTTP MCP server, and a `charming` CLI; HTTP uses Charming bearer tokens and some team endpoints also require a session cookie.
